Project Manager Artificial Intelligence / Generative Artificial Intelligence (m/w/d)
.

KI ist kein Hype, sondern der Schlüssel zu einer besseren Nutzererfahrung.

Unsere KI-Initiativen, wie der S-KIPilot für die Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe, stehen im Zentrum unserer nutzerzentrierten IT- und Geschäftsstrategie. In dieser Rolle werden Technologie, Business und Nutzerbedürfnisse zusammengeführt und sichergestellt, dass KI in Europas größter Finanzgruppe zum strategischen Erfolgsfaktor wird. Hier wird nicht nur Einfluss genommen, sondern neue Standards gesetzt.

Deine Aufgaben:

Werde der Architekt der Zukunft: Übernimm die Leitung (oder Stellvertretende Leitung) innovativer Projekte im Bereich Generative Künstliche Intelligenz, die unsere Branche revolutionieren – von der ersten Idee bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei hast du stets die Nutzer im Fokus, um Lösungen zu entwickeln, die den Menschen das Leben erleichtern.
Inspiriere und motiviere: Führe dein Projekt-Team mit Leidenschaft und einer klaren Vision, sodass jeder einzelne über sich hinauswächst und gemeinsam mit dir Großes erreicht.
Setze neue Standards: Bewältige Herausforderungen und finde kreative Lösungen, die nicht nur die Ziele erreichen, sondern neue Maßstäbe setzen – immer unter Berücksichtigung der Bedürfnisse der Nutzer:innen.
Übernimm die Verantwortung für eine breite Nutzerreichweite: Du trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass die von dir geleiteten Projekte nicht nur innovativ, sondern auch für eine breite Nutzerschaft zugänglich und relevant sind.
Kommuniziere mit Power: Ob mit deinem Projekt-Team oder mit Führungskräften – du sorgst dafür, dass alle wissen, wohin die Reise geht und warum deine Projekte unaufhaltsam sind. Dabei legst du besonderen Wert auf den Austausch mit den Endnutzer:innen, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Bedürfnisse erfüllt werden.
Denke weiter und setze neue Maßstäbe: Dein Mut, Neues zu wagen, wird uns dabei unterstützen, die nächste Generation von Künstliche Intelligenz-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die den Nutzer:innen echten Mehrwert bieten.
Arbeite agil und selbstorganisiert: Du bist vertraut mit agilen Methoden und kannst flexibel sowie selbstorganisiert auf neue Anforderungen reagieren. Du treibst eine moderne Arbeitskultur voran, die Raum für Kreativität und schnelle Anpassungen schafft – und so New Work erlebbar macht.

Dein Profil:

Erfahrung, die zählt: Du hast bereits mehrere erfolgreiche Projekte gemanagt und idealerweise Erfahrung im Bereich Generative Künstliche Intelligenz oder IT-Projekte gesammelt.
Bildung und Weitsicht: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet dein Fundament. Generative Künstliche Intelligenz ist dir vertraut, und du kennst Technologien wie Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPT) und Transformer-Netzwerke – und weißt, wie du sie einsetzen kannst, um nutzerzentrierte Lösungen zu entwickeln. Mind. 6 Jahre fachbezogene Berufserfahrung.
Führungsstärke: Du bist ein echter Leader:in, der mit Entschlossenheit und Weitblick vorangeht. Herausforderungen sind für dich kein Hindernis, sondern eine Einladung, noch besser zu werden.
Agilität im Blut: Agile Methoden sind für dich mehr als nur ein Konzept – sie sind die Grundlage deines Erfolgs und helfen dir, Projekte flexibel und effektiv zu steuern, immer mit Blick auf den Nutzen für die Anwender:innen.
Kommunikation, die bewegt: Du kannst komplexe Themen klar und überzeugend vermitteln und alle Beteiligten mit auf die Reise nehmen, wobei du die Bedürfnisse der Nutzer:innen nie aus den Augen verlierst.
Du strebst nach Exzellenz: Eigeninitiative, Selbstorganisation, kreative Lösungen, der Drang, ständig weiterzukommen, ein positives Mindset und Leidenschaft – das zeichnet dich aus. Dein Wissenshunger und deine Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen, treiben dich an, nutzerzentrierte Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Warum du bei uns nicht fehlen darfst:

Gestaltungspower: Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, Projekte zu leiten, die wirklich zählen und die Zukunft prägen, indem sie den Nutzer:innen echten Mehrwert bieten.
Inspirierendes Umfeld: Triff auf ein Team, das genauso leidenschaftlich und ehrgeizig ist wie du. Gemeinsam erreicht ihr Großes, indem ihr die Nutzer:innen in den Mittelpunkt stellt.
Gemeinsames Wachstum: Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zu leisten. Deine Expertise im Bereich Generative Künstliche Intelligenz wird dabei eine zentrale Rolle spielen.
Gemeinsame Erfolge: Du gestaltest Projekte, die nicht nur begeistern, sondern auch Maßstäbe setzen – und dabei den Nutzer:innen echten Nutzen bringen.

.

Municipal Engineering Project Manager

ms consultants, inc.
Youngstown, Ohio

Are you an experienced municipal engineer who enjoys leading projects, building trusted client relationships, and helping communities plan for their future?

At ms consultants, inc., we’re looking for a Municipal Engineering Project Manager to join our team in Northeast Ohio. This is an opportunity to take a leadership role in delivering impactful municipal infrastructure projects while helping expand our client partnerships and municipal engineering services throughout Northeast Ohio and Western Pennsylvania.

The successful candidate will play a key role in managing projects from planning through design and implementation while serving as a trusted advisor to municipal clients. This position combines technical project management, client relationship development, and business development, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the communities we serve while helping expand our regional presence.

ms consultants has provided comprehensive municipal engineering services to communities throughout Northeast Ohio. Our work helps municipalities address infrastructure challenges, plan for future growth, and improve the quality of life for their residents. At ms, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of client relationships, lead meaningful infrastructure initiatives, and collaborate with a multidisciplinary team committed to delivering practical, high-quality solutions.

Help us help improve our communities, one project at a time!

What You’ll Do:

Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with municipal clients by understanding their priorities, proactively addressing their needs, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction
Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and develop new projects based on community needs, infrastructure priorities, and long-term capital improvement goals
Advise municipal clients on capital improvement planning, project development, funding strategies, and infrastructure investment priorities
Support the preparation of requests for proposals and qualifications, and other business development initiatives
Develop and maintain relationships with regulatory agencies and funding organizations to identify funding opportunities and help clients navigate project requirements
Perform project management duties on a wide variety of project types including: water/wastewater/storm improvements, street improvements, culvert upgrades, sidewalk replacement, curb replacement, funding procurement, plan review, etc
Lead projects from initial planning through design and implementation, establishing project scopes, schedules, budgets, and delivery strategies to achieve client objectives
Coordinate engineering design efforts across multiple business units and technical disciplines, ensuring effective collaboration, clear communication, and efficient project execution
Ensure that assigned projects are executed and completed on time and within budget

We are seeking a collaborative, client-focused engineering professional who combines creative problem-solving and sound technical judgment with strong communication and leadership skills. They thrive in a multidisciplinary, balancing client needs, technical excellence, and practical solutions to deliver successful projects.

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or other relevant field
Professional Engineering (PE) License (Ohio)
Project Management Experience
Relevant experience in a wide variety of municipal engineering services

Excellent verbal and written communication skills including public speaking
Ability to effectively communicate verbally complex engineering concepts across a wide variety of audiences including but not limited to: Engineers, Contractors, Elected Officials, and the General Public
Exceptional critical thinking, strong problem solving, and decision making abilities
Familiarity with federal and state funding agencies and programs

We are proud to be an award-winning engineering, architecture, planning and environmental consulting firm, annually ranking within ENR’s Top 500 Design Firms. We are dedicated to helping these clients achieve their goals through integrated, innovative solutions, and outstanding customer service.

We offer a career path which provides opportunities for advancement at any level of your career and costs for licensure, certifications, and further education. At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Business Process Manager

We Are Hiring 3 Implementation Managers To Drive Our Global Quote-to-Order Transformation. You Will Join a Key Initiative To Standardize Commercial Processes And Digital Solutions Across Our Business. Apply For The Region That Matches Your Profile And Career Aspirations

Europe — Flexible location across European countries
America — Flexible location across American countries
Asia — Flexible location across Asia (excl. China)

Each role is autonomous and high-impact, with direct influence on how our commercial operations work in your region.

About The Role

Join ABB Robotics as an Implementation Manager and drive the implementation and adoption of our global Quote-to-Order process and supporting digital solutions.

The role will work closely with country commercial organizations to understand their current ways of working, introduce the global Quote-to-Order process, identify gaps and local requirements, and support countries through the transition to the target process and tools. The current solution landscape includes CPQ and the commercial Quote-to-Order processes interfacing with SAP S/4HANA
, together with other supporting applications. The scope may evolve as the Quote-to-Order process and application landscape develops. The position is part of the Commercial Excellence – Quote to Order Process
organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.
Act as the primary business process advisor and second-level tool support contact for your region's countries — balancing process discipline with pragmatic tool troubleshooting
Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.
Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries through the change management process.
Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.
Experience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. You are equally confident with business and technical audiences.
Experience working across multiple countries and in matrix organizations; structured, self-driven and ownership-oriented.
Fluent in English; local or regional language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently within your region, particularly during implementation phases.

The Ideal Candidate

You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. You know how to sit with a country team, understand how they work today, and guide them confidently toward a standardized global process, without losing sight of legitimate local needs. You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.

CRS is seeking Program Manager candidates for an anticipated integrated Shelter and WASH Response for Newly Arrived Refugees and Persons with Specific Needs (PSNs) in Nakivale and Rhino Camp Refugee Settlements. You will ensure effective systems and processes are in place to support high-quality programming that advances Catholic Relief Services' (CRS) mission of serving poor and vulnerable populations.

The Program Manager will be responsible for the overall planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of project activities in line with the project scope of work, results framework, and M&E plan. Critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills with ability to make sound judgment.
